pr.title: debug: open Run and Debug wherever its view container is docked
pr.body:
Fixes #337458

`debug.openDebug` (`openOnSessionStart`, `openOnFirstSessionStart`, `openOnDebugBreak`) and the F5 fallback when no debuggers are installed (`debug.openView`) opened the Run and Debug container with `paneCompositeService.openPaneComposite(VIEWLET_ID, ViewContainerLocation.Sidebar)`. That call goes to the primary side bar, which only opens containers registered in it. Once the container is moved to the secondary side bar (or the panel), nothing happens.

These three call sites now use `IViewsService.openViewContainer(VIEWLET_ID)`. It looks up where the container currently lives and opens it there, unhiding that part if needed. Extensions already open their container this way. When the container is in the primary side bar, the underlying call is the same as before, so the default layout is unchanged.

`DebugSession` now injects `IViewsService` in place of `IPaneCompositePartService`, in the same constructor position, so the existing positional test construction is unaffected.

**Testing**
- Debug unit suites pass (435 passing).
- Manual: container moved to the secondary side bar and collapsed, `openOnSessionStart`, F5. Run and Debug opens in the secondary side bar.

Not changed: `debug.openExplorerOnEnd` is gated on primary side bar visibility and has its own semantics. A few other places hard-code the primary side bar the same way (for example `fileActions.ts`, `searchActionsFind.ts`); I left those out to keep this change scoped to debug. Happy to add a unit test if you'd like one.

commit.message:
debug: open Run and Debug wherever its view container is docked

The debug.openDebug setting and the F5 fallback (debug.openView) asked
the primary side bar to open the Run and Debug container. That part only
opens containers registered in it, so nothing happened once the
container was moved to the secondary side bar or the panel.

Open the container through IViewsService.openViewContainer instead,
which resolves the container's current location. Behavior is unchanged
when the container is in the primary side bar.

Fixes #337458
